card.name: Scattered words in history and prize text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words such as Weekly, won, recently, frequently and digits in years, in general web prose about politics, history and awards.

modes.label: Winning or awards
modes.description: Verbs or phrases about winning an election or a prize.
modes.example: In 1948, Müller<< won>> the Nobel Prize for his work with D

modes.label: Time adverbs
modes.description: Adverbs of time or frequency in news-style commentary.
modes.example: most<< recently>> with a law that minimizes the impact

modes.label: Citation pieces
modes.description: Parts of publication names, author names or years in reference lists.
modes.example: by<< Vernon>> J. Williams, Jr. American Journal

card.plain: It responds to a mix of unrelated words in history, politics and citation text, with no single theme.
